desc:
🥷 Welcome to +1 Ninja Jump Escape!

Gain +1 Ninja Power, jump higher, escape every level, and collect trophies!

🏆 Win — Reach the top and earn Trophies
🥷 Upgrade — Unlock powerful Ninja Gear to jump even higher
🌎 Escape — Progress through harder levels and new ninja areas
⚡ Grow Stronger — Increase your Ninja Power and reach insane heights
👑 Become the Best — Climb higher than every other ninja!

👍 Like the game and join the group for special rewards!

Keywords: Ninja, Ninja Jump, Ninja Power, Jumping, High Jump, Escape, Obby, Simulator, Power, Trophies, Upgrades, Parkour, Samurai, Dojo, Climbing
